MCP server for the complete Zabbix API - 237 tools, multi-server, OAuth 2.1 + bearer auth, PDF reports, systemd ready. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, VS Code, Codex, JetBrains and any MCP client.

Kryptorious Tools v2026 is a web-based automation suite for developer workflows involving CLI operations, DevOps, GitHub Actions, npm, and Python tasks.

findings.name: Discovery
findings.description: RFC 8414 `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`, RFC 9728 `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer ... resource_metadata="..."` on 401.

findings.name: Dynamic client registration
findings.description: RFC 7591 `/register`. ChatGPT's "Advanced OAuth settings" auto-detects everything from the discovery documents.

findings.name: Two

findings.name: Refresh
findings.description: token reuse detection** (RFC 6819 §5.2.2.3) - replaying an already-rotated refresh token revokes the entire token family and writes an audit row.

findings.name: Per
findings.description: client IP allowlist + TTL override** in `[oauth_clients.<id>]`, editable from the OAuth Clients page in the admin portal.

findings.name: Login uses the existing admin
findings.description: portal users** ([admin.users.*], scrypt-hashed) - operators do not maintain a second identity store. Login + consent UI mirrors the admin portal theme.

findings.name: Audit log integration
findings.description: every OAuth event (login_success, consent_granted, token_revoked, ...) lands in `audit.log` for forensic reconstruction.

findings.name: Legacy bearer mode keeps working alongside OAuth
findings.description: existing `[tokens.X]` clients need no migration.
